node.statement: Let E be the n-dimensional chart vector space and identify it linearly with R^n. If n=0 the assertion is immediate (the determinant of the unique endomorphism is the empty determinant 1), so assume n>0. Let M=T^n, choose p in M and a smooth chart kappa:B_R(0)->M with kappa(0)=p. Choose 0<r<s<R so small that ||A||s<R, and choose a smooth bump chi on B_R with chi=1 on B_r and support contained in B_s. Define G:M->M by G(kappa(y))=kappa(chi(y)Ay) for y in B_s, and G(q)=p outside kappa(B_s). This is well-defined because ||chi(y)Ay||<R, and it is smooth across the boundary because chi vanishes on a neighbourhood of the boundary of its support. Thus G is a smooth self-map of the compact orientable manifold M, and on kappa(B_r) its coordinate representative is exactly y->Ay.
